scope: q in {13,101}, n in {2,3,4}, 12,160 lines on 80 curves; research/lift_dense_orbit_parity_20261106
statement: Odd characteristic, lines x0+uF_q on y^2=f(x) over F_{q^n}: all 1,287 lines meeting the orbit-parity criterion are all-lift or all-twist; at (101,2) and (101,3) none of 3,520 lines failing it is constant (one chance-constant line at (13,3)). Descent lines (root set stable under the q^(n/2)-Frobenius; curves with j in F_{q^(n/2)}) are all-lift iff chi(u^3)=1; on all-lift ones 0.505-0.615 of lifted x are dead for the largest prime l, and the twist-side rule predicts 405 of 27,880 wrongly, all observed-dead/predicted-alive.
